RetentionClass.description: How long a data category is kept, independent of *why* (see RetentionPolicy.notes).
RetentionClass.title: RetentionClass

description: Declared retention bounds for one data category.

max_age_seconds.description: Delete once an item is older than this. Unset means no automatic age-based expiry (typical for long_term/indefinite).
max_age_seconds.title: Max Age Seconds

requires_tombstone.description: Whether deletion of this category must preserve a tombstone record (lineage-linked artifacts) rather than a bare delete.
requires_tombstone.title: Requires Tombstone

title: RetentionPolicy
